entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return an order.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF789-001.
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloFit Aero Helmet. What specifically is the issue with the helmet?
The color. It looked different online.
I understand that can be frustrating. So just to confirm, is it a technical fault with the item or a preference regarding the color?
I just said. It's the color. The box is unopened, so it's brand new.

Of course. No problem at all, Sam. I see you received it just five days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy. Your safety is our top priority, so we want to ensure you're completely satisfied with protective gear like your helmet.
Fine. So how does this work?

I've just approved the return for you. And since you're a VIP member with us, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. You can just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off.

The moment the item is scanned at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually appears in your account within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
I guess not. It's done, finally.
Alright. Well, thank you for your call, Sam. Have a good rest of your day.
